description: House full of charm (which combines the charm of the old - built in 1890 - and modernity, due to its renovation/extension by an architect in 2022). Our advantages: spacious house (155 m2), a shaded garden and a rooftop terrace to enjoy the sun and the small above-ground pool. Wellness area in the basement: small gym, sauna (4/5 people) and shower/Turkish bath.Transport: 30 min. from the very center of Paris.Olympic Games: 18 min from the Olympic Village.The spaceGround floor: entrance, living room with open kitchen (42 m2), fireplace, toilet no. 1, laundry room (washing machine, dryer...). On the 1st floor: a first bedroom (single or double bed, on request; very bright bedroom, with its 2 windows), bedroom no. 2 (double bed), small bedroom no. 3, a bathroom with toilet no. 2. Possibility to put an extra double bed in the large office (21 m2) on request. On the 2nd and top floor (completely redone in 2022): a master bedroom with king size bed (180/200), a bathroom, separate toilet no. 3, access to the 25 m2 terrace with magnificent unobstructed view.You can enjoy a small quiet garden, without any opposite (table and chairs for lunch/dinner outside, barbecue...).In the basement: in 2023 we set up a small gym (bike, treadmill), a traditional sauna for 4/5 people and a 3rd bathroom (perfect for the Turkish bath after/during the sauna).2 of the 4 bedrooms are equipped with air conditioning. The spacious office (which can be used as room 5) is also equipped with air conditioning.Other things to noteTransport: station 7 minutes' walk (20/25 minutes to reach the very center of Paris = Paris Saint Lazare).
